title: Page 10
content_zh:
“那我喂你。”他把吐司凑到她嘴边。
“不必，我早就成年了。”她一脸正经地推开他的手，要他别闹了。
“你真没情趣。”他埋怨她的不解风情，只好自己吃了。
不过一大早就能吃到爱妻亲手做的早餐，喝到爱妻亲手煮的咖啡，再看着爱妻那张秀丽的脸蛋……
这个早晨，他感受到很不一样的美好。身边多了个心爱的女人，突然觉得世界变得幸福许多，内心洋溢着一股难以形容的轻松与快乐，原来结婚还挺不赖的嘛！
他悠然自得地啜饮咖啡，望着她微笑……
第9章(2)
“对了，有些事要跟你谈谈。”她放下杯子，忽然想到还有事要对他说。
“哦？一大早就有事跟我谈……”他笑得有点贼，手也摸上爱妻的大腿，虽然今天穿的不是黑色丝袜，但那双匀净的美腿看起来还是一样诱人……
她一掌拍掉他不安分的手。
“是正事。”她严肃地强调，不许他态度随便的动手动脚。
“好，正事。”他撇撇嘴，不情愿地收回手，等她说。其实根本不太想跟妻子谈什么正经事，还是调戏她比较好玩……
“关于我欠你的钱……”
看吧，这个开头已经让他有点想打呵欠了。
“以后我会按照约定好的时间汇给你，你要收下。”她坚持要把钱还他，希望他也能按照当初的约定收下还款。
“我都说那些钱不用还了。”他挥挥手，要她别再把那些钱放在心上，他怎么能跟自己的妻子收钱嘛，她真见外。
“不行，我们婚姻要照着约定好的方式走完。”刚好趁着今天清晨醒来的那段时间，她仔细想了一下他们日后的关系。有些事情要照旧，有些事情则必须有所改变。
“走完？！不行，我不准你走。”他马上拉住她的手，一听到“走完”二字就很敏感。无论如何，就是不许心爱的女人离开他。
什么嘛！他们俩昨天才在房里互吐情衷，进行了一场爱的大告白，又历经了数度缠绵悱恻的欢爱而已，今早就在这里谈什么走不走的……
“我的意思是，你不能用不让我还钱的方法逼我留下来，那会让我觉得很不受尊重，所以我还是要把欠你的钱还清。”她坦白地告诉他自己的想法。没有人喜欢被强迫，即使以爱为名也一样。

“所以……你现在还是要跟我离婚吗？”他紧张地问，根本不在乎那些数字的增减，只在意她的去留。
他没有要逼她留下来，而是真心的要和她长相厮守，不想让她离开罢了。
“这个嘛……等我把钱还完你就知道了。”她拉下他的手，有点卖关子地说，心里其实有些坏心地对他的紧张态度感到一丝窃喜。而且老实说，谁又料得到未来是什么情况，昨天的这个时间她都还不晓得他是爱她的呢，可是他们现在却是两心相许的坐在这里，真的成了一对夫妻了。
“什么！为什么要等到那天？这种事现在就可以决定了，我们不离婚！”他不喜欢她这种不确定的答案，那给他一种不安定的感觉，心里有些慌。
他很肯定自己爱着这个女人，也要定了她，所以他绝对不会放她走，要一直和她在一起，这辈子都会对她不离不弃。
“谁知道，也许你明天就爱上别人……”她举例可能的变数。
“我不会。”他坚定地说。
“那也许我明天会爱上别人——”
“你不准！”他火大地警告。
她看着他那脸凶巴巴的神情，轻拧细眉，觉得他这个人真是霸道！
“你看，你现在又在命令我了。每次你这样跟我说话，我就会觉得我在这桩婚姻里只是一项抵押品，因为欠你钱，所以凡事都要矮你一截。”她真的不喜欢这种好像有把柄握在别人手上的感觉，虽然这也是她自找的，可是她绝对不要这样的关系一直继续下去，所以才更要把钱还清，结束这种不对等的关系。
“我……没有那个意思。”他表示自己没有看低她的意思，说话的气焰马上收敛了一点，虽然他是真的想把她永远押在身边。
“但是我会那样觉得，所以等我把钱还完，我会再重新考虑我们的婚姻关系要不要继续维持下去。这点，请你尊重我的选择。”她希望他们的婚姻能先回到平等之上，而不是这种一方亏欠另一方的关系，所以这段时间刚好就让这个浪子留校察看，看看他的表现如何。
“你一定要考虑那么久吗？”他有点可怜地说，突然又觉得她还钱的速度太慢了，拖这么长的时间真的让急性子的他很难熬，而且选择权又不在他手上……
不过现在不给她选，这婚可能又离定了，哎唷，真烦！他烦躁地抓抓头，没想到借钱给人家还有这种困扰……
“不一定，要是我明天突然中了上亿元的头彩，就可以立刻给你答案了。”她打趣地说，难得的幽默。
“哈，哈。”他干笑两声，表情臭得很，现在才没心情跟她开玩笑，说不定再过一、两年他就要变成弃夫了啦！啊……
望着丈夫很不情愿又无奈的表情，她倒是好心情的喝了几口咖啡。
真难得呀，她竟然也会有稍微赢过他的感觉哩！
“还有，虽然目前我还没把钱还清，你还是要尊重我的想法和看法。”这也是很重要的一件事，她觉得有必要再慎重的跟他说清楚。过去她常觉得这个自大狂太嚣张了，有时候真的会把她弄得很生气，却又拿他一点办法也没有。

“我什么时候没尊重你了？”他惊呼，自认自己一直是个很好沟通又讲道理的文明人。
“譬如说你老是和女人闹绯闻，害我变成别人眼中的可怜女人……”她冷睨着他，随便举例就是个血淋淋的惨案。
“哎呀，那都是过去的事了，以后绝对不会再发生了，我发誓。”他笑着推推她，要她别一早就吃这么重的醋，谁没有过去嘛……重要的是活在当下和展望未来啊！
“还有像上次硬是搬进房间要我把床换回来……”简直是霸道加厚脸皮，完全没有在考虑她的意愿。
“那完全是为了培养感情，不然昨晚咱们怎么会聊得那么开心。”他抱着她，亲亲她的脸，说明那是不得不为的事情，一切都是为了和她共创更美好的将来，而且昨天他们也都玩得很开心呀！
“总之，以后我说不要、不想或不喜欢的事，请你都要尊重我的意愿，不能勉强我。”她拉下他在她腰上磨蹭的手，板着脸告诉他。这是要求，不是商量，没得议价。
“可是看到你说不想的表情，我就会更想要你……”他神情嗳味地勾唇浅笑，看她愈正经，他就愈冲动，这也是没法控制的事。
说来说去，都怪她模样太吸引人。这算是她的问题！
“杜天海！”她恼怒地瞪着他，现在可不是在跟他说笑，她是很认真的！
“是，我知道了。”他边说边喝咖啡，态度教人质疑。
但她早有准备……
“很好，把你刚才说的写下来，签名。”她把早备妥的纸笔放到他面前。
“什么？！”他难以置信，没想到她居然做到这样……
这算什么！这不是摆明了不相信他的承诺，污辱他的人格吗？
“不然到时候说话不算话怎么办？”她只是实事求是，有字有证据嘛。
“喂！难道我是那种会耍赖的人吗？”他扬眉瞪眼地问道。
content_en:
"Then I'll feed you." He put the toast to her mouth.
"No need, I'm an adult a long time ago." She pushed his hand away with a serious face and asked him to stop making trouble.
"You're so boring." He complained about her incomprehension and had to eat it himself.
But early in the morning, I can eat breakfast cooked by my beloved wife, drink coffee brewed by my beloved wife, and look at my beloved wife’s beautiful face...
This morning, he felt a very different kind of beauty. With a beloved woman around me, I suddenly feel that the world has become a lot happier, and my heart is filled with an indescribable sense of relaxation and joy. It turns out that getting married is not a bad thing!
He sipped coffee leisurely and looked at her and smiled...
Chapter 9(2)
"By the way, I have something to talk to you about." She put down the cup and suddenly thought of something else she wanted to say to him.
"Oh? You have something to talk to me about early in the morning..." He smiled a little bit, and touched his beloved wife's thighs with his hands. Although he was not wearing black stockings today, those neat and beautiful legs still looked as attractive...
She slapped his restless hand away.
"It's business." She emphasized seriously, not allowing him to do anything casually.
"Okay, let's get down to business." He curled his lips and reluctantly took back his hand, waiting for her to say. In fact, I don’t really want to talk about anything serious with my wife, it’s more fun to tease her...
"About the money I owe you..."
Look, this beginning already made him want to yawn a little bit.
"I will remit it to you according to the agreed time in the future, and you have to accept it." She insisted on returning the money to him, hoping that he would also accept the repayment as agreed.
"I said you don't have to pay back the money." He waved his hand and asked her not to take the money to heart anymore. How could he collect money from his wife? She really didn't care.
"No, our marriage must be completed as agreed." She happened to take advantage of the time when she woke up this morning to think carefully about their future relationship. Some things will remain the same, and some things will have to change.
"Finished?! No, I won't allow you to leave." He immediately took her hand and became very sensitive when he heard the word "finished". No matter what, he just doesn't allow his beloved woman to leave him.
What! The two of them just confessed their feelings to each other in the room yesterday, made a big confession of love, and experienced several lingering love moments. What can they talk about here this morning and whether they can leave...
"I mean, you can't force me to stay by not letting me pay back the money. That would make me feel disrespected, so I still have to pay off the money I owe you." She told him her thoughts frankly. No one likes to be forced, even in the name of love.
"So...are you still going to divorce me now?" He asked nervously, not caring about the increase or decrease in those numbers, only caring about whether she would stay or go.
He didn't force her to stay, but he really wanted to stay with her forever and didn't want her to leave.
"Well...you'll know after I finish paying back the money." She pulled his hand down and said a bit coquettishly, feeling a little secretly happy at his nervous attitude in her heart. And to be honest, who can predict what will happen in the future? At this time yesterday, she didn't even know that he loved her, but now they are sitting here with their hearts in love, and they have really become a couple.
"What! Why do you have to wait until that day? This kind of thing can be decided now, we are not getting divorced!" He didn't like her uncertain answer, which gave him an unsettled feeling and made him feel a little panicked.
He is very sure that he loves this woman and wants to fix her, so he will never let her go. He will always be with her and will never leave her in this life.
"Who knows, maybe you will fall in love with someone else tomorrow..." She gave an example of possible variables.
"I won't," he said firmly.
"Then maybe I'll fall in love with someone else tomorrow—"
"You're not allowed!"He Huodi warned.
She looked at the ferocious expression on his face and slightly frowned, feeling that he was really overbearing!
"Look, you are ordering me again now. Every time you talk to me like this, I will feel that I am just a collateral in this marriage. Because I owe you money, I am inferior to you in everything." She really didn't like this feeling of having control in other people's hands. Although she asked for it, she definitely didn't want this relationship to continue, so she had to pay off the money and end this unequal relationship.
"I... didn't mean that." He said that he didn't mean to look down on her, and his arrogance in speaking immediately calmed down a bit, although he really wanted to keep her by his side forever.
"But I feel that way, so after I pay back the money, I will reconsider whether our marriage relationship should continue. Please respect my choice on this point." She hoped that their marriage could return to equality first, rather than a relationship where one party owes the other party, so this period of time just happened to let the prodigal son stay in school for probation to see how he performed.
"Do you have to think about it for so long?" He said a little pitifully, suddenly feeling that her repayment speed was too slow. It was really difficult for him to have such a long delay, and the choice was not in his hands...
But if I don't give her a choice now, the marriage may be divorced again. Ouch, how annoying! He scratched his head irritably. He didn't expect that lending money to others would be such a problem...
"Not necessarily. If I suddenly win a jackpot worth hundreds of millions of dollars tomorrow, I can give you the answer right away." She said jokingly, showing a rare sense of humor.
"Ha, ha." He laughed dryly, with a foul expression on his face. He was not in the mood to joke with her now. Maybe he would become an abandoned husband in a year or two! Ah...
Looking at her husband's reluctant and helpless expression, she took a few sips of coffee in a good mood.
It's so rare that she actually feels like she has slightly defeated him!
"Also, although I haven't paid back the money yet, you still have to respect my thoughts and opinions." This was also a very important thing, and she felt it was necessary to explain it to him carefully. In the past, she often felt that this arrogant man was too arrogant and would really make her angry sometimes, but there was nothing she could do about him.
"When did I not respect you?" he exclaimed, thinking that he had always been a civilized person who communicated well and was reasonable.
"For example, you always have scandals with women, causing me to become a pitiful woman in the eyes of others..." She looked at him coldly and gave a random example of a bloody tragedy.
"Oh, that's all in the past, and it will never happen again in the future, I swear." He smiled and pushed her, asking her not to be so jealous early in the morning. Who doesn't have the past... The important thing is to live in the present and look forward to the future!
"And like the last time he moved into the room and asked me to change the bed..." He was simply overbearing and shameless, without considering her wishes at all.
"It's all for cultivating feelings. Otherwise, we wouldn't have had such a happy chat last night." He hugged her and kissed her face, explaining that it was something he had to do. Everything was to create a better future with her, and they both had a lot of fun yesterday!
"Anyway, from now on, if I say I don't want, don't want or don't like anything, please respect my wishes and don't force me." She took off his hand that was rubbing on her waist and told him with a straight face. This is a request, not a discussion, no negotiation.
"But seeing the expression on your face when you say you don't want to, I will want you even more..." He raised his lips in a sweet smile. The more serious she looked, the more impulsive he became, which was something he couldn't control.
After all, it's all because she looks so attractive. This is her problem!
"Du Tianhai!" She glared at him angrily. She was not joking with him now, she was serious!
"Yes, I understand. "He said while drinking coffee, his attitude was questionable.
But she was prepared...
“Very well, write down what you just said and sign it. "She put the paper and pen she had prepared in front of him.
"What? ! "He couldn't believe it. He didn't expect her to do this...
What's this! Doesn't this make it clear that you don't believe in his promise and insult his character?
“Otherwise, what if the words don’t turn out to be true? "She is just seeking truth from facts, and she has words and evidence.
"Hey! Am I the kind of person who knows how to cheat? he asked with raised eyebrows and eyes wide.
